item.title: Museum Avenue in Dothan closed Monday
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- Monday, January 12 there will be intermittent lane closures on Museum Avenue for construction at the Wiregrass Innovation Center. Drivers will be directed around the work area by drums and flaggers. The City of Dothan asks drivers to exercise caution.
